title: Tenure Credit Terms for Denied Convex Barrier Charges (Ostomy Supply Program)
content:
**Customer terms - Ostomy Supply Program.** A tenure credit is deducted from the charge for plan-denied convex barriers (A4407) of a program's most recent convex-barrier refill, according to how long the program has been active and whether a non-covered item charge was posted on it recently.

**Terms.**
- *Months active* are the whole calendar months from the program's activation date to the day the charge is worked out.
- *Recent non-covered item charge* means a non-covered item charge posted on the program in the last 24 months (posting date fewer than 24 whole calendar months before that day).

| Months active | Non-covered item charge in the last 24 months | Tenure credit |
|---|---|---|
| 36 or more | None | USD 15.00 (the long-tenure credit) |
| At least 12 but fewer than 36 | None | USD 5.00 (the mid-tenure credit) |
| 36 or more, or 12 to 35 | One or more | No credit |
| Fewer than 12 | Any | No credit |

**How the credit acts.** The tenure credit is deducted from the rounded amount; the charge after the credit is never below zero and is rounded to the cent.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical).**
- 35 months active, no recent non-covered item charge: USD 5.00. At 36 months: USD 15.00.
- 11 months active: no credit. At 12 months: USD 5.00.
- A charge amount of USD 3.20 for a program earning USD 5.00: the charge after the credit is USD 0.00, never negative.
